dedupe_keys.name: calendar ageing test results on commercial 18650 li ion cell 25 c and 45 c

description: VITO provides calendar-ageing results for commercial nickel-rich/silicon-graphite 18650 cells. The native title identifies twenty-five and forty-five degrees Celsius. Test conditions vary state of charge and temperature and use two cells each. Reference tests periodically interrupt ageing. The source points to EVERLASTING test documentation and another registered data link, whose exact release equivalence is not asserted. Simulation uses: the EVERLASTING parent collection establishes calibration inputs for predicting electric-vehicle battery behaviour, lifetime and range. Coverage: exact measurement periods remain unstated. Access: public native metadata describes the release and stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The title temperatures distinguish this release from zero/ten-degree tests and from cycle-ageing protocols. Precise test dates, state-of-charge values and sampling intervals remain unstated.
